description: This file contains a React component for a client-side UI that enables users to upload documents categorized as resumes, job descriptions, or performance reviews. It manages file selection, drag-and-drop uploads, and communicates with backend APIs for document uploads and orchestration to generate a persona based on uploaded documents.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts a number of bytes into a human-readable string with units.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension label for a given filename or 'FILE' if none is found.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a random string ID for uploaded files.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for the given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Provides the display title for each upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns the color associated with each upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Specifies acceptable file types for uploads.
